critique: The neon celestial matrix has a recognizable sci-fi RPG identity, yet most nodes share the same circular treatment and the surrounding dashboard follows a familiar generic HUD template. Class fantasy is communicated mostly through labels and glow rather than distinctive symbols or branch character.
suggestion: Give each skill branch a content-specific visual motif and silhouette, introduce one memorable capstone node and semantically varied node scales, and extend the celestial discipline theme into bespoke icons and restrained constellation textures rather than adding arbitrary colors.
audit_note: Direct Codex critic output grounded in the shared r0 screenshot; not an API raw-response object.
